_about: Decision points for the MATCH step. Triggers are official NWS / PTWC / CPHC products with their published definitions; actions and owners are proposals. proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans.
status: proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans

pre_season_hurricane.definition: 'The season officially begins on June 1 and ends on November 30.'

hurricane_watch.issuer: NOAA NWS / Central Pacific Hurricane Center
hurricane_watch.definition: 'sustained winds of 64 knots (74 mph or 119 km/hr) or higher are possible within the specified area' ... 'issued 48 hours in advance of the anticipated onset of tropical storm force winds.'

hurricane_warning.issuer: NOAA NWS / Central Pacific Hurricane Center
hurricane_warning.definition: 'sustained winds of 64 knots (74 mph or 119 km/hr) or higher are expected' ... 'issued 36 hours in advance of the anticipated onset of tropical-storm-force winds.'

tsunami_warning.definition: 'A tsunami warning is issued when a tsunami with the potential to generate widespread inundation is imminent' (or expected/occurring). Hawaii should refer only to PTWC messages for its region.

flash_flood_warning.definition: 'A Flash Flood Warning is issued when a flash flood is imminent or occurring.'

red_flag_warning.definition: 'NWS issues a Red Flag Warning when fire conditions are ongoing or expected to occur shortly.'

coastal_flood_warning.definition: 'Issued when tidal flooding or storm induced flooding is occurring, imminent or highly likely along coastal areas within approximately the next 12 hours.'
coastal_flood_warning.note: Added for the coastal_flood scenario; not in the original trigger list.

pre_season_no_notice.definition: No-notice hazard: plan as if there is no warning lead time (team_assumption). County sets the review date.

county_evacuation_order.definition: Official county order; not an NWS product.

after_all_clear.definition: Hazard has passed; recovery sheltering begins.

shelter_access_notice.product: Before each season: who may use shelters (no official product)
shelter_access_notice.definition: Team proposal: the county confirms and publishes who may use public shelters and what ID, if any, is needed, before an event, so residents are not turned away or afraid to come.
shelter_access_notice.note: Proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans. Not a NWS/PTWC product, so no URL.
